title: Marine claims he was on the USAF flight out of Campinas

tellings.quote: claimed to have been part of the Varia operation from Campenis. It was Youf. He goes, "I was on the flight."

plain: A US Marine claims he was aboard a US Air Force flight out of Campinas, Brazil, in 1996 as part of the operation at Varginha, a Brazilian town where creatures were reportedly captured that year. The documentary filmmaker James Fox tells Michels he got this in an email from the Marine, who did not give his name: 'I was on the flight.' If true, it would mean the US military helped take something out of Brazil.
